title: Arcana Core Field: First Steps
summary: Begin with Aether Signal and shared identifiers before building deeper magic loops.

blocks.title: Name The Signal
blocks.body: Confirm the player-facing concept first: Aether Signal is the readable trace that lets magic behave like a system instead of a mystery switch.

blocks.title: Keep Contracts Stable
blocks.body: Use Arcana Core definitions for spells, rituals, curses, relics, and providers so every addon can agree on the same records.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first Arcana Core win is a definition that appears in a knowledge surface and remains safe when the optional gameplay addon is absent.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
